chapters.reason: Titans explicitly use a neural memory module that acts as fast-adapting parameters updated via gradient-based optimization steps, aligning with the Test-time training (TTT) paradigm.
The paper describes the memory module as treating the hidden state as fast-adapting parameters updated by a learnable optimizer, which is the definition of Gradient-State Recurrence.
The architecture incorporates linear recurrent components to handle long-term dependencies, which relates to the broader category of linear-state recurrence mechanisms.
